history: All six SE001/SE002 Train EDFs (H=6, 36 characters); no subsets
k0: Not reported: S3 has no allowed data for R at k=0

conditions.A: history + current, no alignment (main design; must reproduce history_amount H=6)
conditions.current_only: current only, no alignment (must reproduce history_amount H=0)

reference_data.SE003: First k calibration characters only; never the last-six validation characters, Test, Static or unlabeled current data

trials_for_reference: Policy-A retained flashes (after filtering and guard/fault exclusion), all flashes regardless of label; labels are never used to compute R
covariance: Per retained 0-800 ms epoch, temporal channel demeaning, ddof=1, uV^2; arithmetic mean over epochs (identical to session_drift_descriptive_v1)
transform: X -> R_s^(-1/2) X via symmetric eigendecomposition; applied before 16x16 window-mean features; implemented on cached features because window means commute with channel-space linear maps, verified against raw epochs at run time
validation: SE003 Train last six characters, aligned with R_S3(k) computed from the first k characters only
model: SWLDA with the frozen main settings; EEGNet only if SWLDA meets the predeclared clear-change rule
primary_metric: Validation flash ROC-AUC, same exclusions as the main experiment (7,560 flashes, 7,340 retained)

decision_rules.report_only: Results never change the main design and never re-select it
decision_rules.direction_rule: Direction is 'consistent' only if at least 8 of 10 subjects share the sign of the macro mean difference; otherwise report per subject and draw no conclusion from the mean
decision_rules.clear_change_for_eegnet: Any k where macro B-A CI excludes 0, direction is consistent, and |macro B-A| >= 0.01 AUC

highlight_reason: Largest S1-to-S3 versus S2-to-S3 drift asymmetry in session_drift_descriptive_v1
limits: At k=3 R_S3 rests on about 378 flashes and may be unstable; R_S3(k) to R_S3(12) distance is reported
EA is linear; SWLDA then z-scores pooled training features, so the per-feature scaling interacts with EA
Only session-wise EA is tested; Riemannian alignment and other variants are out of scope
scope: Exploratory sensitivity analysis on Train validation. Does not change the main design or any reported result. No Test.
